name: SawWiden
tagline: A mono-safe stereo widener for spreading supersaws without smearing them. The dry centre is never touched; a moving side signal is added to the left and subtracted from the right, so it cancels when summed to mono.
screen_note: SawWiden has no custom parameters of its own (num_param is 0). It uses the xd's two mod FX knobs, TIME and DEPTH, so the one-higher display rule for typeless parameters does not apply.

knobs.name: TIME
knobs.what: Movement speed of the side signal, from about 0.05 Hz (slow drift) up to about 4 Hz (lively shimmer), exponential feel.

knobs.name: DEPTH
knobs.what: Width. Lowest = no side signal (dry), highest = very wide.

notes: How it works: two delay taps (up to about 42 ms) moved by 3-phase LFOs, string-ensemble style, high-passed near 150 Hz so the low end stays in the middle, then used as the side signal.
problems: No problems are recorded in this repo. If something sounds wrong on your synth, please open an issue and say which firmware you have.
status: Version 1.0. The unit in dist/ was built from this repo's source.
No test on a real minilogue xd is recorded in this repo yet. Treat it as a test build and tell us what you hear.
Linux install steps are not tested yet.
